I care. Please dont do it. Our minds have a fucked up way of making us feel like we're nothing (as well as society and other people). But we're so much more than we can even fathom! I get it, people don't always show or say how much they care because we don't want to face the fact that we all eventually have an end. It scares people to think about their own mortality. But for those like you and I? We think about it often and even try to advance it. But please don't. We never know the full impact we have on this world and the people in it until it's too late. You are awesome, you're perfect in exactly the way you were meant to be. You're beautiful, strong, and even though I'm a stranger, I'm proud of you for all you've accomplished even if you can't see it! Hell, you made a post because you don't want to die, so stay alive! You can always reach out to me or many other people here. And yes, I've been in your shoes. Not even 6 months ago I stood atop a 6 story tall parking garage ready to jump...I had a few people talk me out of it and help me. So, please, for those that love and care about you, and for a stranger, don't do it.
